datasets.title: ETOPO 2022 surface elevation, 10 arc-minute subset of the 60 arc-second grid
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

z.description: surface elevation relative to EGM2008, positive up; ice-sheet tops over Greenland and Antarctica

datasets.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work, NOAA NCEI)
datasets.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
datasets.notes: OPeNDAP subset: every 10th sample of the 60 arc-second surface grid (1080 x 2160, float32, DAP2 binary). Land is z > 0 m, ocean z <= 0 m; depth = -z. If NCEI's server ever returns different bytes the checksum check fails; a new registry version is then needed (data unchanged). Alternative: the full 60 arc-second netCDF (about 478 MB), checksum not pinned.

datasets.title: NOAA ERSST v5 monthly long-term mean sea surface temperature, 1991-2020
datasets.publisher: NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (data: NOAA NCEI)

sst.description: sea surface temperature, annual mean of the 12 monthly long-term means

datasets.license: Public domain (NOAA); the file's license attribute reads 'No constraints on data access or use'
datasets.acknowledgement: NOAA ERSST V5 data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA, from their website at https://psl.noaa.gov
datasets.citation: Huang, B., P. W. Thorne, V. F. Banzon, T. Boyer, G. Chepurin, J. H. Lawrimore, M. J. Menne, T. M. Smith, R. S. Vose, and H.-M. Zhang, 2017: Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature, Version 5 (ERSSTv5): Upgrades, Validations, and Intercomparisons. J. Climate, 30, 8179-8205.

datasets.title: MODIS MOD17A3 annual net primary production, mean of 2000-2015 (Collection 5.5, 30 arc-second)
datasets.publisher: Numerical Terradynamic Simulation Group (NTSG), University of Montana
datasets.http_only: files.ntsg.umt.edu serves this file over plain HTTP only (the HTTPS endpoint timed out on 2026-11-22); integrity comes from the pinned size and SHA-256

npp.description: annual net primary production, mean of 2000-2015 (band 1, uint16 x 0.1); 65535 = fill (ocean, barren, ice, urban)

datasets.license: NASA-funded MODIS product, openly distributed by NTSG with no stated restrictions; NASA Earth Science data policy (open data, no restrictions)
datasets.citation: Zhao, M., Heinsch, F. A., Nemani, R. R., & Running, S. W. (2005). Improvements of the MODIS terrestrial gross and net primary production global data set. Remote Sensing of Environment, 95, 164-176. Also: Zhao, M., & Running, S. W. (2010). Drought-induced reduction in global terrestrial net primary production from 2000 through 2009. Science, 329, 940-943.
datasets.notes: GeoTIFF 43200 x 16800, LZW, one row per strip, 80N to 60S, Last-Modified 2016-07-02; product readme: http://files.ntsg.umt.edu/data/NTSG_Products/MOD17/GeoTIFF/MOD17A3/readme.txt. Read strip by strip as means of 12 x 12 valid pixels (0.1 degree; research R1 of specs/012-living-planet). Land/ocean from ETOPO 2022 (z > 0) because the file stores ocean and barren land alike as fill. Not the current v061 (LP DAAC), which needs Earthdata Login.

datasets.title: MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll-a, monthly, 2013-2024 (R2022.0 L3 SMI, every 12th 4 km pixel, about 0.5 degree)
datasets.publisher: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group; distributed by NOAA NMFS SWFSC ERD (CoastWatch ERDDAP)

chlor_a.description: chlorophyll-a concentration (OCI algorithm); mean over all valid months per pixel

datasets.license: NASA Earth Science data policy: open data, no restrictions (https://science.nasa.gov/earth-science/earth-science-data/data-information-policy/)
datasets.citation: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group (2022). MODIS-Aqua Level-3 Mapped Chlorophyll Data, Version R2022.0. NASA Ocean Biology DAAC, doi:10.5067/AQUA/MODIS/L3M/CHL/2022. Distributed by NOAA NMFS SWFSC ERD (ERDDAP dataset erdMH1chlamday_R2022SQ).
datasets.acknowledgement: Data served by NOAA CoastWatch West Coast Node ERDDAP (https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/).
datasets.notes: One ERDDAP request: 142 monthly composites (2024 has 10), 360 x 720, netCDF-3, chlor_a(time, latitude, longitude) float32, NaN fill. ERDDAP builds the file on request and writes the request time into the global history attribute, so the file bytes change per request; the pin is content_sha256 over the decoded data and coordinates (specs/012-living-planet research R2). If it fails, the data changed: check it against the previous copy and pin a new version.
